description: This file is a C++ source implementation for the TensorFlow Lite NNAPI delegate, containing definitions for creating and managing NNAPI models and operations, interfacing with NNAPI hardware, and handling various TFLite operations and their translation into NNAPI commands.

classes.name: NnapiMappingContext
classes.description: Holds mapping information between TFLite tensors/nodes and NNAPI tensors/operations during model conversion.

classes.name: NNMemory
classes.description: Represents shared memory used in NNAPI, including creating shared memory regions and managing their lifecycle.

classes.name: DequantizeMapping
classes.description: Tracks mapping of quantized tensors to dequantized floating point tensors for reuse in NNAPI graph.

classes.name: NNAPIOpBuilder
classes.description: Helps construct NNAPI operations, manage operands, and translate TFLite operators into NNAPI model nodes.

methods.name: NnApiBackendId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string for the NNAPI delegate backend based on options.

methods.name: NnApiErrorDescription
methods.description: Converts NNAPI error codes into human-readable string descriptions.

methods.name: GetDeviceHandle
methods.description: Looks up and retrieves a NNAPI device handle by device name.

methods.name: GetHash
methods.description: Calculates a hash value for a TfLiteIntArray, optionally combined with a previous hash.

methods.name: HasZeroes
methods.description: Checks whether a TfLiteIntArray contains zero values.

methods.name: GetTargetFeatureLevel
methods.description: Determines the maximum feature level supported by target NNAPI devices.

methods.name: ShouldUseTargetDevices
methods.description: Decides whether to target specific NNAPI devices based on delegate options.

methods.name: GetTargetDevices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of NNAPI device handles based on delegate options and device availability.

methods.name: NNMemory::Create
methods.description: Creates and maps shared memory for use with NNAPI, platform-dependent implementation.

methods.name: NNMemory::~NNMemory
methods.description: Cleans up shared memory resources during destruction.

methods.name: DequantizeMapping::DequantizedAnnIndex
methods.description: Finds existing dequantized tensor index matching quantized tensor index and type.

methods.name: DequantizeMapping::Add
methods.description: Records a new dequantization mapping between quantized and floating point tensor.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddScalarBoolOperand
methods.description: Adds a scalar boolean operand to NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddScalarInt32Operand
methods.description: Adds a scalar int32 operand to NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddScalarFloat32Operand
methods.description: Adds a scalar float32 operand to NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddVectorInt32Operand
methods.description: Adds an int32 vector operand to NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddPoolingParams
methods.description: Adds pooling parameters as operands to NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddTensorInput
methods.description: Adds an input tensor operand reference to the NNAPI model, with options for hybrid ops.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddTensorOutput
methods.description: Adds an output tensor operand reference to the NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddOperationToModel
methods.description: Inserts an operation with specified inputs and outputs into the NNAPI model.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddDequantize
methods.description: Adds a dequantize operation for a tensor if not already present and replaces tensor input indices.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AppendReshape
methods.description: Adds a reshape operation to match TFLite tensor shape after NNAPI processing.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AppendRequantize
methods.description: Adds an operation to requantize an intermediate NNAPI tensor to match TFLite output scale and zero point.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformPackIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Transforms a PACK operation in TFLite into supported NNAPI operations (CONCAT + RESHAPE).

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformUnpackIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Transforms an UNPACK operation into NNAPI RESHAPE + SPLIT.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformSplitVIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Transforms a SPLIT_V operation into multiple NNAPI SLICE operations.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformSquaredDifferenceIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Transforms a SQARED_DIFFERENCE operation into NNAPI SUB + MUL.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformCosIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Transforms a COS operation into a combination of NNAPI SUB and SIN ops.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::FinalizeAddOperation
methods.description: Finalizes and adds an NNAPI operation, then clears temporary operands.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::AddSingleValueTensorAsScalarOperand
methods.description: Adds a tensor with a single value as a scalar operand.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::CalculateQuantizationParams
methods.description: Calculates quantization scale and zero point given min/max float range.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformHardSwishIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Lowers a HARD_SWISH activation into a sequence of supported NNAPI operations.

methods.name: NNAPIOpBuilder::TransformSquaredDifferenceIntoSupportedOps
methods.description: Transforms a SQUARED_DIFFERENCE operation into NNAPI SUB + MUL.
